mapper.insert: insert into dc_member_coupon (mc_status, mc_issued, mc_expired, m_no, co_no) values ('UNUSED', sysdate, #{mcExpired}, #{mNo}, #{coNo})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dc_member_coupon where m_no = #{mNo} and co_no = #{coNo}

select mc.mc_no, mc.mc_status, mc.mc_issued, mc.mc_expired, mc.mc_used, mc.used_order_no, mc.m_no, mc.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason from dc_member_coupon mc join dc_coupon c on mc.co_no = c.co_no where mc.mc_no = #{mcNo}

select mc.mc_no, mc.mc_status, mc.mc_issued, mc.mc_expired, mc.mc_used, mc.used_order_no, mc.m_no, mc.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason from dc_member_coupon mc join dc_coupon c on mc.co_no = c.co_no where mc.m_no = #{mNo} order by mc.mc_issued desc

select mc.mc_no, mc.mc_status, mc.mc_issued, mc.mc_expired, mc.mc_used, mc.used_order_no, mc.m_no, mc.co_no, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason from dc_member_coupon mc join dc_coupon c on mc.co_no = c.co_no where mc.m_no = #{mNo} and mc.mc_status = 'UNUSED' and (mc.mc_expired is null or mc.mc_expired >= sysdate) order by c.co_val desc

select mc.mc_no, mc.mc_status, mc.mc_issued, mc.mc_expired, mc.mc_used, mc.used_order_no, mc.m_no, mc.co_no, m.m_id, c.co_name, c.co_type, c.co_val, c.co_max_amt, c.co_min_amt, c.co_scope, c.co_reason from dc_member_coupon mc join dc_coupon c on mc.co_no = c.co_no join dc_member m on mc.m_no = m.m_no order by mc.mc_issued desc
mapper.update: update dc_member_coupon set mc_status = 'USED', mc_used = sysdate, used_order_no = #{usedOrderNo} where mc_no = #{mcNo}
update dc_member_coupon set mc_status = 'EXPIRED' where mc_status = 'UNUSED' and mc_expired is not null and mc_expired < sysdate
